codec.conversion: Explicit opt-in, exact SHA-256 verification, torch.load(weights_only=True), complete strict state validation, then Safetensors export.

tokenizer.implementation: VoiceHub SentencePiece BPE plus the official multi-character CJK split

training.codec_policy: AudioVAE V2 is frozen and used only for preprocessing/validation decode.
training.reference_layout: [103, reference_audio, 104, text, 101, target_audio, 102]; loss applies only to target audio.

limits: The native runtime implements offline batch-size-one autoregressive synthesis; upstream streaming acceleration is not claimed.
External text normalization and denoising are intentionally outside the model boundary.
The official AudioVAE requires a one-time explicit legacy conversion until upstream publishes Safetensors.
